limits: Only private Free Valkey 8 was live-tested; Postgres, service disks, application/network/scaling/bar consumers are source-traced.
Resource responses held unchanged for seven seconds in a complete one-operation KeyValue batch; series batches held unchanged contain four DatastoreMetrics operations.
Failed initial capture attempts did not observe pending and are excluded from findings.
First short-viewport desktop-ready/mobile-pending crops were clipped; complete replays at same widths and taller 1400px viewport are the cited screenshots.
An incidental ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED cleared on fresh navigation; no reproducible network-failure bug filed.
No cybersecurity or permission testing, data writes, client connections, paid purchases or product implementation.
True empty UI observed early; unavailable/error/throttle/HA/multiseries transitions were not induced live.
